ex.zh: 物價上漲，所以我們相應調整預算。

ex.en: Please reply by Friday; otherwise, we will cancel the order.
ex.zh: 請在週五前回覆，否則我們會取消訂單。

ex.en: The road is closed; therefore, we will take another route.
ex.zh: 道路封閉，因此我們改走其他路。

ex.en: The plan is good. However, it is too expensive.
ex.zh: 這計畫很好。不過太貴了。

usage: however 是副詞，前面常用句號或分號

ex.en: Although it was raining, the event was a success.
ex.zh: 雖然下雨，活動仍很成功。

usage: although 不和 but 一起用

ex.en: Unless you have a ticket, you cannot enter.
ex.zh: 除非有票，否則不能進入。

ex.en: Please let me know whether you can attend.
ex.zh: 請告訴我你是否能出席。

ex.en: Despite the rain, many people came.
ex.zh: 儘管下雨，還是很多人來。

syn.note: in spite of 意思相同
although 是連接詞，後接句子

usage: despite 後接名詞，不接句子

ex.en: In spite of the delay, the project was successful.
ex.zh: 儘管延誤，專案仍很成功。

ex.en: The flight was canceled due to bad weather.
ex.zh: 班機因天候不佳取消。

senses.en: The report is due on Friday.

ex.en: Owing to the heavy rain, the event was postponed.
ex.zh: 由於大雨，活動延期。

ex.en: We were late because of the traffic.
ex.zh: 我們因為塞車遲到。

ex.en: Let's meet on Thursday instead of Friday.
ex.zh: 我們改週四見面，不要週五。

ex.en: According to the report, sales rose by 5 percent.
ex.zh: 根據報告，業績上升 5%。

ex.en: In addition to salary, we offer bonuses.
ex.zh: 除了薪水，我們還提供獎金。

ex.en: The hotel has a pool as well as a gym.
ex.zh: 飯店有游泳池，也有健身房。

ex.en: Apart from the price, I like the design.
ex.zh: 除了價格，我喜歡這個設計。

usage: apart from 可表示「排除」或「另外還有」

ex.en: The office is empty except for the security guard.
ex.zh: 除了保全，辦公室沒有人。

ex.en: We ship to all countries regardless of size.
ex.zh: 不論大小，我們都寄送到所有國家。

ex.en: In case of fire, use the stairs.
ex.zh: 萬一發生火災，請走樓梯。

syn.note: in the event of 較正式

ex.en: In terms of price, this model is the best.
ex.zh: 就價格而言，這款最好。

ex.en: With regard to your request, we need more time.
ex.zh: 關於您的要求，我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: The recruitment process takes about a month.
ex.zh: 招募流程大約一個月。

ex.en: A recruiter called me about a job opening.
ex.zh: 一位招募人員打給我談一個職缺。

ex.en: The company has frozen hiring this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年凍結招聘。

ex.en: The factory provides employment for 500 people.
ex.zh: 這間工廠提供 500 人就業機會。

ex.en: Unemployment fell to 3 percent.
ex.zh: 失業率降到 3%。

ex.en: The company employs over 2,000 people.
ex.zh: 這家公司雇用超過兩千人。

ex.en: The job fair attracted many job seekers.
ex.zh: 就業博覽會吸引了很多求職者。

ex.en: We have a large applicant pool this year.
ex.zh: 今年應徵的人選很多。

ex.en: Please send your resume and cover letter.
ex.zh: 請寄履歷和求職信。

ex.en: Designers should include a portfolio with their application.
ex.zh: 設計師應徵時應附上作品集。

ex.en: She has a background in finance.
ex.zh: 她有財務方面的背景。

ex.en: Do you have any work experience in sales?
ex.zh: 你有業務的工作經驗嗎？

ex.en: We need someone with expertise in marketing.
ex.zh: 我們需要具備行銷專業的人。

ex.en: Applicants must be proficient in English.
ex.zh: 應徵者須精通英文。

ex.en: She is fluent in English and Japanese.
ex.zh: 她英日文流利。

ex.en: We need a competent accountant.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位能勝任的會計。

ex.en: She is capable of managing the project.
ex.zh: 她有能力管理這個專案。

ex.en: We are looking for highly motivated people.
ex.zh: 我們在找非常積極的人。

ex.en: We need a reliable supplier.
ex.zh: 我們需要一家可靠的供應商。

ex.en: He is a dependable worker.
ex.zh: 他是個可靠的員工。

ex.en: Who is responsible for the event?
ex.zh: 誰負責這個活動？

ex.en: She is very organized and efficient.
ex.zh: 她非常有條理又有效率。

ex.en: The position requires a detail-oriented person.
ex.zh: 這個職位需要注重細節的人。

ex.en: The staff were enthusiastic about the new project.
ex.zh: 員工對新專案很熱衷。

ex.en: We are eager to work with you.
ex.zh: 我們很期待與您合作。

ex.en: We are looking for a team player.
ex.zh: 我們在找有團隊精神的人。

ex.en: She showed strong leadership during the project.
ex.zh: 她在專案中展現強大的領導力。

ex.en: She took the initiative to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 她主動解決了問題。

ex.en: The company is looking for new talent.
ex.zh: 公司在尋找新人才。

ex.en: She is a talented designer.
ex.zh: 她是一位有才華的設計師。

ex.en: He is a gifted speaker.
ex.zh: 他是天生的演說家。

ex.en: Each new employee is assigned a mentor.
ex.zh: 每位新員工都會分配一位導師。

ex.en: She supervises the night shift.
ex.zh: 她負責督導夜班。

ex.en: New staff work under supervision for the first month.
ex.zh: 新人第一個月在督導下工作。

ex.en: He oversees all production at the plant.
ex.zh: 他監督工廠所有的生產。

ex.en: A good manager listens to subordinates.
ex.zh: 好的主管會聽部屬的意見。

ex.en: Please ask your superior for approval.
ex.zh: 請找你的上司核准。

senses.en: This model is superior to the old one.

ex.zh: 她是一家銀行的高階主管。

ex.en: He is a senior engineer.
ex.zh: 他是資深工程師。

ex.en: She started as a junior accountant.
ex.zh: 她從初級會計做起。

ex.zh: 我們在招募入門職位。

ex.en: We need an experienced driver.
ex.zh: 我們需要有經驗的司機。

ex.en: He is young and inexperienced.
ex.zh: 他年輕又缺乏經驗。

ex.en: Please welcome the newcomers to our team.
ex.zh: 請歡迎加入我們團隊的新人。

ex.en: Newly hired staff must attend orientation.
ex.zh: 新進員工必須參加新人說明會。

ex.en: The onboarding process takes two weeks.
ex.zh: 新人到職流程需要兩週。

ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀職務說明。

ex.en: Your duties include answering phones and filing.
ex.zh: 你的職責包括接電話和歸檔。

ex.en: Employees receive overtime pay for weekend work.
ex.zh: 週末上班的員工有加班費。

ex.zh: 全職員工有 14 天有薪假。

ex.en: She will be on maternity leave until June.
ex.zh: 她會休產假到六月。

ex.en: He took two weeks of paternity leave.
ex.zh: 他請了兩週陪產假。

ex.zh: 你有幾天年假？

ex.en: Full-time employees receive health benefits.
ex.zh: 全職員工享有健康福利。

ex.en: He receives a monthly pension.
ex.zh: 他每月領退休金。

ex.en: The company offers a generous retirement plan.
ex.zh: 公司提供優渥的退休計畫。

ex.zh: 這份工作提供具競爭力的薪酬。

ex.zh: 公司對表現好的人提供獎勵。

ex.zh: 業務員每筆銷售都有佣金。

ex.zh: 每月 5 號發薪。

ex.zh: 我的薪水直接匯入帳戶。

ex.zh: 員工將調薪 3%。

ex.zh: 她向經理要求加薪。

ex.zh: 公司宣布裁員 200 人。

ex.en: The factory laid off 50 workers.
ex.zh: 工廠裁了 50 名工人。

ex.en: He was dismissed for being late too often.
ex.zh: 他因常遲到被解雇。

senses.en: She dismissed the idea as too expensive.

ex.en: The union protested the dismissal.
ex.zh: 工會抗議這次解雇。

ex.en: She handed in her resignation yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天遞出辭呈。

ex.en: The notice period is one month.
ex.zh: 離職預告期是一個月。

ex.en: We hired three contract workers for the project.
ex.zh: 我們為這個專案雇了三名約聘人員。

ex.en: She works as a freelance designer.
ex.zh: 她是自由接案的設計師。

ex.en: We hired a freelancer to write the content.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位自由工作者撰寫內容。

syn.note: contractor 偏工程或專案承包

ex.en: He has been self-employed for ten years.
ex.zh: 他自己創業十年了。

ex.en: Labor costs have risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年人工成本上升。

ex.en: The labor union negotiated a pay increase.
ex.zh: 工會談成了加薪。

ex.en: Safety in the workplace is very important.
ex.zh: 職場安全非常重要。

ex.en: The office dress code is business casual.
ex.zh: 公司服裝規定是商務休閒。

ex.en: All staff must wear a uniform.
ex.zh: 所有員工都要穿制服。

ex.zh: 年度考核在十二月進行。

ex.zh: 我們下週會審查你的申請。

ex.zh: 我的績效考核在下週一。

ex.en: The manager praised the team for their hard work.
ex.zh: 經理稱讚團隊的努力。

ex.en: The plan was criticized for being too costly.
ex.zh: 這計畫因成本太高受到批評。

ex.en: We welcome constructive criticism.
ex.zh: 我們歡迎建設性的批評。

ex.en: The company recognized her for ten years of service.
ex.zh: 公司表揚她服務滿十年。

ex.en: She received recognition for her work.
ex.zh: 她的工作獲得肯定。

ex.en: We reward customers who refer friends.
ex.zh: 我們回饋推薦朋友的顧客。

usage: a rewarding job＝有成就感的工作

ex.en: Winning the award was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 得獎是很大的成就。

ex.en: We accomplished our goal ahead of schedule.
ex.zh: 我們提前達成目標。

ex.en: Her greatest accomplishment was opening the Tokyo office.
ex.zh: 她最大的成就是成立東京辦公室。

ex.en: Everyone contributed ideas to the project.
ex.zh: 每個人都為專案貢獻了想法。

usage: contribute to 後接名詞或動名詞

ex.en: Thank you for your contribution to the team.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對團隊的貢獻。

ex.en: She dedicated herself to helping customers.
ex.zh: 她全心投入協助顧客。

ex.en: He is a dedicated employee.
ex.zh: 他是一位盡心盡力的員工。

ex.en: We appreciate your dedication to the company.
ex.zh: 我們感謝你對公司的付出。

ex.en: We are committed to quality.
ex.zh: 我們致力於品質。

ex.en: We have a strong commitment to safety.
ex.zh: 我們對安全有堅定的承諾。

ex.en: The bonus helped boost staff morale.
ex.zh: 獎金提升了員工士氣。

ex.en: Money is not the only motivation for work.
ex.zh: 錢不是工作唯一的動力。

ex.en: The new software improved productivity.
ex.zh: 新軟體提升了生產力。

ex.en: Absenteeism has dropped since we introduced flextime.
ex.zh: 實施彈性上班後缺勤率下降了。

ex.en: The first agenda item is the budget.
ex.zh: 第一個議程項目是預算。

ex.en: The chairperson opened the meeting.
ex.zh: 主席宣布會議開始。

ex.en: The facilitator kept the discussion on track.
ex.zh: 引導者讓討論保持在主題上。

ex.en: The moderator introduced each speaker.
ex.zh: 主持人介紹每一位講者。

ex.en: A panel of experts will answer questions.
ex.zh: 專家小組會回答問題。

ex.en: Each panelist will speak for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 每位座談成員發言十分鐘。

ex.en: A good manager knows how to delegate.
ex.zh: 好的主管懂得委派工作。

syn.note: assign 指派工作；delegate 強調把自己的權責交給下屬
entrust 強調信任對方而交付重要事物

ex.en: We can't vote because there is no quorum.
ex.zh: 因為未達法定人數，無法表決。

ex.en: Please take notes during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時請做筆記。

ex.en: Who will be the note-taker today?
ex.zh: 今天誰負責記錄？

ex.en: The meeting was adjourned until Friday.
ex.zh: 會議休會到星期五。

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因下雨取消。

ex.en: Let's wrap up the meeting by five.
ex.zh: 我們五點前結束會議吧。

ex.en: The report concludes that costs must be cut.
ex.zh: 報告的結論是必須削減成本。

ex.en: We reached a conclusion after a long discussion.
ex.zh: 長時間討論後我們得出結論。

ex.en: Let me recap the main points.
ex.zh: 讓我回顧一下重點。

ex.zh: 這份報告提供市場概況。

ex.en: Please outline your proposal in one page.
ex.zh: 請用一頁概述你的提案。

ex.en: That's a good point.
ex.zh: 說得好。

ex.en: What is the main point of the article?
ex.zh: 這篇文章的重點是什麼？

ex.en: Please list the key points on one slide.
ex.zh: 請把關鍵重點列在一張投影片上。

ex.en: We need to discuss this matter in private.
ex.zh: 這件事我們需要私下討論。

ex.en: Safety is our main concern.
ex.zh: 安全是我們最關心的事。

ex.en: Several people raised questions about the budget.
ex.zh: 有幾個人對預算提出疑問。

ex.en: Please send me your comments by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在週五前把你的意見寄給我。

ex.en: He made a few remarks about the new design.
ex.zh: 他對新設計說了幾句話。

ex.en: From the customer's viewpoint, the price is too high.
ex.zh: 從顧客的角度看，價格太高。

ex.en: We need a fresh perspective on the problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要用新的角度看問題。

ex.en: There is a strong argument for lowering prices.
ex.zh: 有充分的理由支持降價。

ex.en: What is the reason for the delay?
ex.zh: 延誤的原因是什麼？

ex.en: Many residents opposed the new road.
ex.zh: 很多居民反對新道路。

ex.en: Some members objected to the plan.
ex.zh: 有些成員反對這個計畫。

ex.en: Does anyone have any objections?
ex.zh: 有人反對嗎？

ex.en: We reached a compromise on the price.
ex.zh: 我們在價格上達成妥協。

ex.en: The decision was unanimous.
ex.zh: 這個決定全體一致通過。

ex.en: The majority of staff agreed with the plan.
ex.zh: 大多數員工同意這個計畫。

ex.en: Only a minority of customers complained.
ex.zh: 只有少數顧客抱怨。

ex.en: The board rejected the proposal.
ex.zh: 董事會否決了提案。

ex.en: Sales declined by 5 percent last month.
ex.zh: 上個月業績下降 5%。

ex.zh: 我們接受各大信用卡。

ex.zh: 我提議再多雇兩個人。

ex.en: I recommend the fish.
ex.zh: 我推薦魚料理。

ex.en: We followed the consultant's recommendations.
ex.zh: 我們採納了顧問的建議。

ex.zh: 我們建議顧客提早預訂。

ex.zh: 你可以給我一些建議嗎？

ex.zh: 她說服客戶簽約。

ex.zh: 我相信這計畫會成功。

ex.zh: 業務員示範機器怎麼運作。

ex.zh: 這張圖說明了我們的成長。

ex.zh: 簡報者在演講後回答問題。

ex.zh: 使用視覺輔助讓簡報更清楚。

ex.zh: 公司承諾更加透明。

ex.zh: 可以借你的雷射筆嗎？

ex.en: The speaker stood at the podium.
ex.zh: 講者站在講台前。

ex.en: The lecture will be held in the main auditorium.
ex.zh: 演講將在大禮堂舉行。

ex.zh: 今年的業務大會在拉斯維加斯。

ex.en: The trade show will be at the convention center.
ex.zh: 商展在會議中心舉行。

ex.zh: 公司舉辦職場安全論壇。

ex.zh: 她在醫學研討會上演講。

ex.zh: 領袖們在經濟高峰會上會面。

ex.zh: 我們和東京辦公室有遠距會議。

ex.zh: 面試會以視訊會議進行。

ex.zh: 午餐後有分組討論。

ex.zh: 請確認出席名單。

ex.zh: 請佩戴名牌。

ex.zh: 達到一百萬用戶是重大的里程碑。

ex.zh: 一位知名運動員代言這個品牌。

ex.zh: 新款將在五月推出。

ex.zh: 產品在商展上首次亮相。

ex.en: Market research shows strong demand.
ex.zh: 市場調查顯示需求強勁。

ex.en: Please fill out the questionnaire.
ex.zh: 請填寫問卷。

ex.en: We tested the ad with a focus group.
ex.zh: 我們用焦點團體測試廣告。

ex.en: We want to expand our customer base.
ex.zh: 我們想擴大客群。

ex.en: Our target market is young professionals.
ex.zh: 我們的目標市場是年輕上班族。

ex.en: The ad's target audience is teenagers.
ex.zh: 這則廣告的目標受眾是青少年。

ex.en: This product is popular with an older demographic.
ex.zh: 這產品受年長族群歡迎。

ex.en: The company found a niche in eco-friendly products.
ex.zh: 公司在環保產品找到利基市場。

ex.en: This segment of the market is growing fast.
ex.zh: 這個市場區隔成長很快。

ex.en: Competition in the industry is strong.
ex.zh: 這個產業競爭激烈。

ex.en: We offer competitive prices.
ex.zh: 我們提供具競爭力的價格。

ex.en: The two companies are rivals.
ex.zh: 兩家公司是競爭對手。

ex.en: Sales projections for next year look good.
ex.zh: 明年的業績預測看起來不錯。

ex.en: Sales reach their peak in December.
ex.zh: 銷售在十二月達到高峰。

ex.en: There was a boom in online shopping.
ex.zh: 網購激增。

ex.en: Sales slumped in the first quarter.
ex.zh: 第一季業績暴跌。

ex.en: Many companies cut jobs during the recession.
ex.zh: 經濟衰退期間很多公司裁員。

ex.en: The sales figures for May are excellent.
ex.zh: 五月的銷售數字非常好。

ex.en: We met our sales target this month.
ex.zh: 我們這個月達成業績目標。

ex.en: Each salesperson has a monthly quota.
ex.zh: 每位業務員都有每月業績額度。

ex.en: Staff turnover is high in this industry.
ex.zh: 這個產業人員流動率很高。

usage: 英式 turnover 常指營業額

ex.en: Our profit margin is about 20 percent.
ex.zh: 我們的利潤率約 20%。

ex.en: The store has a 50 percent markup on clothing.
ex.zh: 這家店服飾加價 50%。

ex.en: There is a 20 percent price reduction on all items.
ex.zh: 所有品項降價 20%。

ex.en: Everything in the clearance sale is half price.
ex.zh: 清倉特賣所有商品半價。

ex.en: At this price, the laptop is a real bargain.
ex.zh: 這個價格，這台筆電真划算。

senses.en: We bargained for a lower price.

ex.en: This special offer ends on Sunday.
ex.zh: 這個特惠到週日截止。

ex.en: You can use this voucher for a free meal.
ex.zh: 你可以用這張券換一頓免費餐點。

ex.en: We gave our top seller a gift certificate.
ex.zh: 我們送業績最好的人一張禮券。

ex.en: Free samples are available at the booth.
ex.zh: 攤位有免費試用品。

ex.en: Try our software free with a 30-day trial.
ex.zh: 免費試用我們的軟體 30 天。

ex.en: Please read our refund policy before buying.
ex.zh: 購買前請閱讀退款規定。

ex.en: Our return policy allows 30 days.
ex.zh: 我們的退貨規定是 30 天內。

ex.en: The product is sold through major retailers.
ex.zh: 產品透過大型零售商販售。

ex.en: We buy our stock from a wholesaler.
ex.zh: 我們向批發商進貨。

ex.en: We are looking for a distributor in Europe.
ex.zh: 我們在找歐洲的經銷商。

ex.en: The company handles distribution in Asia.
ex.zh: 公司負責亞洲的配銷。

ex.en: You can buy this car from any dealer.
ex.zh: 任何經銷商都買得到這台車。

ex.en: The coffee chain has over 500 franchises.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡連鎖有超過 500 家加盟店。

ex.en: The hotel chain has locations in 20 countries.
ex.zh: 這個飯店集團在 20 國有據點。

ex.en: Customers trust this brand name.
ex.zh: 顧客信任這個品牌。

ex.en: The ad improved our brand image.
ex.zh: 這則廣告提升了我們的品牌形象。

ex.en: The hotel has a good reputation for service.
ex.zh: 這家飯店服務口碑很好。

ex.en: We value customer loyalty.
ex.zh: 我們重視顧客忠誠度。

ex.en: Good service builds customer loyalty.
ex.zh: 好的服務建立顧客忠誠度。

ex.en: Most of our customers come by word of mouth.
ex.zh: 大部分顧客是靠口碑來的。

ex.en: Visit our online store for more items.
ex.zh: 更多商品請逛我們的網路商店。

ex.en: E-commerce sales grew by 30 percent.
ex.zh: 電子商務業績成長 30%。

ex.en: All merchandise is 20 percent off.
ex.zh: 所有商品八折。

ex.en: You can see the cars in our showroom.
ex.zh: 你可以在展示間看車。

ex.en: Please visit our booth at the trade show.
ex.zh: 歡迎到商展參觀我們的攤位。

ex.en: We will exhibit at the trade fair in Frankfurt.
ex.zh: 我們將在法蘭克福商展參展。

ex.en: She made a great sales pitch to the client.
ex.zh: 她對客戶做了很棒的推銷。

ex.en: Please send us a quotation for 500 units.
ex.zh: 請給我們 500 件的報價。

senses.en: a quotation from a famous writer

ex.en: We closed a deal with a major client.
ex.zh: 我們和大客戶談成交易。

syn.note: seal a deal 意思相同

ex.en: A sales representative will contact you.
ex.zh: 業務代表會跟你聯絡。

ex.en: Your account manager will handle all orders.
ex.zh: 您的客戶經理會處理所有訂單。

ex.en: The salesperson showed us several models.
ex.zh: 店員給我們看了幾款。

ex.en: We don't use telemarketing.
ex.zh: 我們不做電話行銷。

ex.en: The financial statements are audited every year.
ex.zh: 財務報表每年都會稽核。

ex.en: The balance sheet shows our assets and debts.
ex.zh: 資產負債表列出資產和負債。

ex.en: The income statement shows a profit this year.
ex.zh: 損益表顯示今年獲利。

ex.en: Careful budgeting helped us save money.
ex.zh: 謹慎編列預算讓我們省錢。

ex.en: Expenditure on marketing rose last year.
ex.zh: 去年行銷支出上升。

ex.en: Moving to a smaller office will reduce overhead.
ex.zh: 搬到較小的辦公室會降低營運費用。

ex.en: We must lower our operating costs.
ex.zh: 我們必須降低營運成本。

ex.en: Rent is one of our fixed costs.
ex.zh: 房租是我們的固定成本之一。

ex.en: The company reported higher earnings this quarter.
ex.zh: 公司本季公布的盈餘較高。

ex.en: Net profit rose by 12 percent.
ex.zh: 淨利成長 12%。

ex.en: Gross profit is revenue minus the cost of goods.
ex.zh: 毛利是營收減去商品成本。

ex.en: The company had a budget deficit last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年預算赤字。

ex.en: We have a surplus of office chairs.
ex.zh: 我們辦公椅太多了。

ex.en: The company paid off its debt.
ex.zh: 公司還清了債務。

ex.en: How much do I owe you?
ex.zh: 我欠你多少？

ex.en: The bank lent us money to buy the equipment.
ex.zh: 銀行借錢讓我們買設備。

ex.en: Can I borrow your pen?
ex.zh: 可以借你的筆嗎？

ex.en: They took out a mortgage to buy the house.
ex.zh: 他們辦房貸買房。

ex.en: You can pay in six monthly installments.
ex.zh: 你可以分六期按月付款。

ex.en: We made a 20 percent down payment on the house.
ex.zh: 我們付了房子 20% 的頭期款。

ex.en: We will credit the refund to your account.
ex.zh: 退款會入到你的帳戶。

senses.en: She deserves credit for the success.

ex.en: The amount will be debited from your account.
ex.zh: 款項會從你的帳戶扣除。

ex.en: Payment can be made by wire transfer.
ex.zh: 可以用電匯付款。

ex.en: The invoice is payable within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張發票須於 30 天內付款。

ex.en: Accounts receivable increased this month.
ex.zh: 本月應收帳款增加。

ex.en: Please send invoices to accounts payable.
ex.zh: 請把發票寄給應付帳款部門。
